claim: An existing artifact is reused only when it is still valid for the inputs at hand — same input digest and same producer version — and every decision records which way it went and why.
denial_type: n/a — this app returns a Decision, it does not raise

steps.label: the inputs and producer version are unchanged
steps.note: Validity is checked against what the artifact was made from, never against when it was made.

steps.label: one file was added to the inputs
steps.note: The failure that matters is not a slow rebuild. It is a fast, confident answer computed from inputs that have since changed.

steps.label: the stored digest is not a well-formed SHA-256
steps.note: An untrustworthy record is not a reason to skip work.

steps.label: the same inputs, built as a dict in a different order
steps.note: Digests are taken over canonical JSON, so key order is not a change.

steps.label: the same files, listed in a different order
steps.note: A list is ordered data, not a set. Treating the two as equal would be a guess about what the list means.
